pages.text: One cloudy afternoon, <name> spotted a sparkling umbrella leaning against the garden gate. Curious, he picked it up and opened it — “Whoosh!” Candy drops of every color rained down from the sky!

“Wow! Candy from the clouds!” <name> cheered, catching bright red gummies and shiny chocolate coins. The dog barked and tried to catch the falling treats, while the cat leapt and swatted at a bouncing candy.

<name> spun around, and oops! Too much candy fell at once. The garden turned into a sticky, colorful mess. His friends slipped on chocolate puddles, giggling as they tried to run. One candy landed on the swing, spinning it like a merry-go-round.

Quickly, <name> laughed and thought, I need to share this magic. He held the umbrella carefully, letting just a gentle sprinkle of candy fall. The pets chased only a few drops, and friends picked candies from the grass without slipping.
Soon, everyone had little piles of candy in their hands. <name> handed out chocolates and gummies, sharing laughs with friends, the cat, and the dog.
As the sun peeked out, the umbrella sparkled once more. <name> marveled at the magical surprise and thought, What a sweet adventure!
